query:
SELECT 
  sl.id,
  sl.contestId,
  sl.entryNumber,
  sl.champion1TokenId,
  sl.champion2TokenId,
  sl.champion3TokenId,
  sl.champion4TokenId,
  sl.schemeTokenId,
  sl.predictedScore,
  sl.actualScore,
  sl.status,
  sl.isWinningLineup,
  sl.createdAt,
  c.name as contestName,
  c.status as contestStatus,
  c.rarity_restriction,
  c.start_time,
  c.end_time
FROM saved_lineups sl
LEFT JOIN contests c ON sl.contestId = c.id
ORDER BY sl.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 30;
